NICE is the design process used throughout Technology Commons. It is a cycle, not a checklist.

## N: Needs & Necessities

Identify the problem, the people involved, the constraints, and the things the solution must accomplish.

## I: Investigate & Inquire

Ask questions, research existing solutions, study standards and techniques, and gather the information needed to make good decisions.

## C: Create & Communicate

Sketch, model, code, build, test, document, and explain the work so that other people can understand what was created and why.

## E: Evaluate

Compare the result with the original needs and necessities. Use evidence to decide what worked, what did not, and what should change next.

The result of Evaluate feeds back into Needs & Necessities, beginning the next cycle.
